body.description: Don Beto, an old man who tells ghost stories: wide straw sombrero, striped wool serape in orange, red and green over his shoulders, tan trousers, weathered face. a person of a small South Texas border town generations after the sky turned white, sun-faded patched clothes, dust on the boots
body.style_description: modern indie action-adventure pixel art: chunky stylized proportions, big bold readable silhouette, saturated colours, lineless with strong graphic light and shadow shapes, expressive and punchy
